title: NextEuroTrip — Trip Planner
description: Europe-focused route planner supporting round trips, one-way journeys and base-based exploration. Uses deterministic day-by-day routing, curated destination data and an interactive visited-map generator. Built with Laravel 13, Vue 3 and MySQL.
features: Plan European round trips, one-way journeys and day trips from a base
Build deterministic, ordered day-by-day routes through reviewed destinations
Create shareable visited maps for countries and regional subdivisions
Manage destination content, sources and editorial approvals
workflow: Choose trip origin, shape and available days
Select destinations using curated geographic data
Order feasible stops and distribute them across days
Display the itinerary on a map and optionally generate AI narration
